g.text: For 31,774 cities (3.9 billion people) I compared the distance to their own capital with the
distance to the nearest foreign one. For 39% of people, the foreign capital is closer.

g.text: The 15 countries with the most city dwellers
Share of people closer to a foreign capital, how many that is, and which capital pulls most
DATA GeoNames cities of 15,000+ people and capitals (CC BY 4.0). Great-circle distances.
NOTE Territories counted with their parent state. Without Taipei: 38%. Without capitals of states under 1M people: 39%.
City populations only, about half of humanity.
